profile.headline: Software Engineer at Soomo Learning

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Led front-end development using TypeScript + React, with full-stack development in Ruby on Rails and Next.js
- Orchestrated tech stack modernization: migrated from Create React App, Webpacker, and CoffeeScript to TypeScript, Vite, and SWC, reducing build times by 4-10x
- Developed and integrated AI chat component supporting OpenAI and Anthropic LLM platforms
- Led development team in implementing WCAG 2.2 AA compliance for accessibility improvements company-wide
- Improved user experience and performance by reducing bundle sizes by up to 65%

positions.title: Contract Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Designed and developed an iPad app as part of a research study into client-directed cueing for aphasia using Ionic, HTML/CSS, and TypeScript.
- Participated in development and implementation of study protocol, resulting in increase of 29% accuracy at baseline to 79% accuracy at conclusion of study.
- Created a command-line tool in Python using IBM's Watson REST/Websocket API to produce automated judgments of stroke survivors’ speech intelligibility.

company.name: Center for Aphasia and Related Disorders (CARD)

positions.title: Speech-Language Pathologist Clinical Fellow
positions.description:
- Independently developed and carried out speech-language treatment as part of Individualized Education Plans for students in special education.
- Conducted screenings and evaluations of students to identify those with special communication needs.
- Collaborated with parents, teachers, and administrators to identify, troubleshoot, and address academic and functional difficulties.

positions.title: Accent Modification Provider
positions.description:
- Led one-on-one sessions with clients to address difficulties with English pronunciation.
- Analyzed clients' speech characteristics to determine areas most affecting intelligibility.
- Designed lesson plans and home practice material to target areas of need.
- Consulted with clients to resolve issues with English communication in professional situations, such as in the classroom and at work meetings.

positions.title: Student Clinician
positions.description:
- Planned and led group therapy sessions for people with aphasia by preparing topics for conversation and multimedia aids.
- Supported clients by providing personalized cueing and assistance during group activities.

positions.title: UNC-CH Division of Speech & Hearing Sciences
positions.description:
- Developed a task-based, naturalistic pronunciation assessment for Global English speakers.
- Independently designed and developed a computerized version of the assessment to facilitate accurate scoring and automated generation of reports using Python and the Qualtrics REST API.
- Trained SLP students in use of the computerized assessment and pronunciation analysis.
- Facilitated a class to help Global English speakers achieve their communication goals.

company.name: University of North Carolina at Chapel Hill

positions.title: Student Clinician
positions.description:
- Planned and independently conducted therapy sessions for children ages 3-18 with various articulation and language therapy needs.
- Independently conducted a variety of pediatric assessments and debriefed assessment results with parents.
- Collaborated with parents to address concerns and guide future therapy goals.

positions.title: Student Clinician
positions.description:
- Independently planned and conducted therapy sessions for children grades K-5 with a variety of developmental language and articulation therapy needs. 
- Worked closely with teachers to monitor progress in the classroom, discuss concerns, and determine areas to address in therapy. 
- Attended IEP meetings and provided counseling to parents based on therapy progress and assessment results.

positions.title: Research Assistant
positions.description:
- Developed Chembench, a collection of machine learning tools for drug discovery (chembench.mml.unc.edu) built using Java (Tomcat, Struts). Led a transition to using Spring DI and Maven for improved dependency management.
- Developed ChemoText, a platform for discovering connections between chemicals, proteins, and diseases using the NIH PubMed database, using a NoSQL graph database that led to speedups of >90% over existing SQL.

company.name: Carolina Exploratory Center for Cheminformatics Research (CECCR)

positions.title: Undergraduate Research Assistant
positions.description: - Curated and prepared datasets for the Management Assistance website for North Carolina social welfare programs (ssw.unc.edu/ma) using SAS and SQL.

company.name: Social Welfare and Health Informatics Group

positions.title: Java Developer, Student
positions.description:
- Designed and created Confluence Wiki plugins in Java to extend internal wiki functionality.
- Created a project progress tracking website using Python (Django), Postgres, and Web technologies (HTML, CSS, jQuery) to enable more effective collaboration among the Mechanical Engineering team.
